name: Quinoa Moong Dal Breakfast Pongal
ingredients: ½ cup quinoa, rinsed very well
¼ cup split yellow moong dal, rinsed
steps: Dry-toast moong dal for 2 minutes in a saucepan until fragrant.
Add quinoa, water, turmeric and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 18–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until quinoa opens and dal is soft.
Heat oil in a small pan. Add cumin, pepper, ginger and curry leaves; sizzle briefly.
Stir tempering into the pongal. Add hot water to loosen if needed and serve warm.
note: Quinoa should be rinsed to remove surface saponins. Protein estimate is per serving.
